definition: Unassuming means modest and quiet in manner, making no claim to importance or attention.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word unassuming. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know unassuming should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The gallery's most collected painter turned out to be an unassuming woman who introduced herself only as 'Ana' and let the canvases do the talking.
Unpretentious is the milder absence—an unpretentious host simply doesn't fake grandeur, while an unassuming one goes further and never angles for notice at all.

Self-effacing goes a step beyond unassuming—the self-effacing engineer actively pushes deserved credit away, while an unassuming one simply never chases it and will still take the floor when the work requires.

Modest describes how someone handles recognition once it arrives—the modest winner downplays the trophy in her hands—and it can also describe plain size, as in a modest income. Unassuming does neither job: it reaches further back, describing a person or thing that never bids for the spotlight in the first place.

Diffident is quietness with self-doubt in it—a diffident speaker hesitates because she is not sure she has earned the floor. Unassuming carries no doubt at all: an unassuming expert may be completely sure of her work and still file no claim to importance.

Regulars at Marquette Park know Sam Okafor as the quiet man who sets up two chess boards by the fountain every Saturday and plays anyone who sits down.
He is unassuming in a way that hides nothing on purpose: he answers questions when asked, but he has never once mentioned that he spent a decade ranked among the top fifty players in the world.
A teenager who searched his name gasped and asked why there was no sign, no fee, no line of students waiting.
'The board is the same size everywhere,' Sam said, resetting the pieces.
When a local paper offered to profile him, he declined politely, suggesting the column space would do more good listing the library's chess night for kids.
